label: slab, Burgers mantle, afterslip on the slab's face
blurb: The three together. A thrust ruptures the 30 km plate, 200 km long; the footwall plate goes on down dip to 150 km as an elastic slab; the mantle around it is a Burgers material; and below the plate, from 30 to 50 km, the megathrust runs down the slab's upper face, where slab and mantle wedge slide past each other at a rate proportional to the shear traction between them. Locked in the earthquake, it slips afterwards.
